definitions.explanation: A grammatical category that locates an event in time, marking past, present, or future. A core term in linguistics and language teaching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時制|じせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{時制|じせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧だ。
examples.english: English has more complex tenses than Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧{時制|じせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧してなく、{現在形|げんざいけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japanese doesn't have an independent future tense; the future is often expressed with the present form.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time) + ⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (system). A specialized linguistic term, used mainly in grammar instruction and academic linguistics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧{時制|じせい}: present tense
- ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧{時制|じせい}: past tense
- ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧{時制|じせい}: future tense
- {時制|じせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧: tense agreement (sequence of tenses)
- {時制|じせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change the tense

SIMILAR WORDS:
- テンス: tense — the loanword equivalent, used in linguistics papers
- {相|そう}: aspect — a related grammatical category (e.g., progressive, perfective)
- ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧: mood — another verbal category (indicative, imperative, etc.)
